AFFRONT.definition: A deliberately offensive act or something producing the effect of deliberate disrespect.
AFFRONT.example: Turning his back on me was a deliberate insult.

FRONT.gloss: the side that is forward or prominent

TORN.definition: Having edges that are jagged from injury.

FONT.definition: A specific size and style of type within a type family.

RANT.definition: A loud bombastic declamation expressed with strong emotion.

FART.definition: A reflex that expels intestinal gas through the anus.

NOT.definition: Negation of a word or group of words.

FAN.definition: A device for creating a current of air by movement of a surface or surfaces.

FAT.definition: A soft greasy substance occurring in organic tissue and consisting of a mixture of lipids (mostly triglycerides).

TON.definition: A United States unit of weight equivalent to 2000 pounds.

RAT.definition: Any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse.

TAN.definition: A browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun.

ANT.gloss: social insect living in organized colonies
ANT.definition: Social insect living in organized colonies; characteristically the males and fertile queen have wings during breeding season; wingless sterile females are the workers.
